A few words about me

Responsibility, organised thinking, real understanding

My relationship with insurance began in 2018, and since 2019 I have worked actively and continuously as an Insurance and Investment Consultant, through the Agency of Ethniki Insurance.

My studies in Accounting, together with many years of experience in sales, shaped the way I approach my work today: with responsibility, organised thinking and a real understanding of every client’s needs.

Frequently asked questions

What you may want to know

Which company do you work with?

I work through the Agency of Ethniki Insurance, as an Insurance and Investment Consultant, actively and continuously since 2019.

What can you help me with?

Health and life insurance, protection for family and property, home, vehicle and business insurance, savings and retirement plans, and investment solutions with financial planning.

How do we start?

With a call to 697 590 0019. We begin by getting to know you: what concerns you, what you already have and what you want to protect. The proposal comes afterwards, tailored to you.

Where can we meet?

At the office, 26 Aidiniou Street in Chaidari (124 61). Call first so we can arrange a time that suits you.

Do you also work with businesses?

Yes. Business insurance is one of the areas I cover, together with home and vehicle insurance.

Can I start saving for retirement?

Yes. With savings and retirement plans you build up capital steadily for later; we will look together at which one fits your goals.

What happens after I sign?

Our collaboration goes on: I offer personal guidance, consistency and support at every stage — from a simple question to the renewal.
